environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB in a private subnet. The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode only, (2) a custom rule group 'app-input-validation' with a single RegexPatternSet rule matching request URI path '/api/users/search' that inspects SingleQueryArgument 'value' against pattern '(?i)(?:union|select|insert|update|delete|drop|;|--|/\*|\*/|0x[0-9a-f]+|char\(|concat\()' with action BLOCK and priority 1, (3) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in BLOCK mode. The ECS task role has no S3 or SSM permissions. Container runs with read-only root filesystem; /var/lib/app is an ephemeral tmpfs volume. ALB access logs are shipped to CloudWatch.
